title: Product reviews
description: What customers wrote about the products they bought.

help.title: About product reviews
help.overview: Ratings and comments customers leave on products they bought. They make up the stars and the review count shown on each product.

sections.title: Each review
items: Only the customer who paid for an order can review its products, once per product per order. Till sales can't be reviewed.
Only the customer who wrote a review can change its rating (1 to 5), title or comment; the order and product never change.
Only an administrator can delete a review, which takes it out of the product's rating.
Reviews of your services are a separate list, under Reviews in Marketplace.
